exclusions: Plastic (Tupperware, Rubbermaid, Ziploc $15-20) stains from tomato/turmeric, absorbs odors, warps in dishwasher, lids lose seal, 3-7 years before replacement. Premium plastic (Sistema, OXO) similar degradation despite higher initial cost. Current Pyrex (soda-lime) less thermal shock resistant than vintage borosilicate (can shatter cold water on hot glass). Lids are weak point for all glass storage-plastic/silicone components consumable but glass itself permanent. This is pragmatic compromise: glass indefinite, accept lid replacement every 5-10 years at $5-15 each (routine maintenance not engineered obsolescence).
